title: Fibonacci Clock
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Fibonacci
learningObjectives: Identify the five Fibonacci squares of value 1, 1, 2, 3, and 5, and explain how their side lengths tile a rectangle in golden-ratio proportion
Calculate the current hour by summing the values of the red and blue squares, and the minutes by summing the green and blue squares and multiplying by 5
Explain why blue squares count toward both the hour and the minute total, while dark gray squares contribute nothing
Decode a displayed clock face into a time, then verify the reading with the Show Time checkbox
Explain why the values 1, 1, 2, 3, and 5 can represent every hour from 1 to 12, and why a given time may have more than one valid square coloring
